look-editor.element.0-dots-moving-dashes.note: Hint under the dot count in the flow look editor. Tells the user that a count of zero draws moving dashes instead of dots.

look-editor.element.0-shapes-nothing-tra.note: Hint under the shape count in the flow look editor. Tells the user that a count of zero sends no shapes along the line.

look-editor.element.4-or-more-glowing-or.text: 4 or more glowing or tube lines on one card. To keep wall tablets smooth, bubbles and flicker are reduced automatically.
look-editor.element.4-or-more-glowing-or.note: Performance warning in the flow look editor. Explains that bubbles and flicker are cut back when a card has four or more glowing or tube lines.

look-editor.element.7-or-more-glowing-or.text: 7 or more glowing or tube lines. Moving highlights and splashes are switched off automatically.
look-editor.element.7-or-more-glowing-or.note: Stronger performance warning in the flow look editor. Explains that highlights and splashes are switched off with seven or more glowing or tube lines.

look-editor.element.a-small-effect-at-th.text: A small effect at the To module each time a shape arrives.
look-editor.element.a-small-effect-at-th.note: Hint under the Splash on arrival switch in the flow look editor. Describes the effect played at the destination module.

look-editor.element.a-tube-under-8-px-is.text: A tube under 8 px is hard to read.
look-editor.element.a-tube-under-8-px-is.note: Warning under the tube width field in the flow look editor. Appears when the width is below 8 px.

look-editor.element.alternate-with.note: Field label in the flow line look. Picks a second moving shape that takes turns with the first. Read as 'Alternate with: [shape]'.

look-editor.element.arrival.note: Section heading in the flow line look for what happens where moving shapes reach the end of the line (for example Splash). A noun.

look-editor.element.arrow.note: Option name for an end marker or moving shape: an arrow. Choice in a button group, not a verb.

look-editor.element.arrowhead.note: Option name for a line end marker: the pointed tip of an arrow. Choice in a button group.

look-editor.element.bubble.note: Option name for a moving shape style (singular), beside Comet, Spark and Drop. Plural 'Bubbles' is a separate key.

look-editor.element.bubble-count.note: Number field label: how many bubbles are on the line at once.

look-editor.element.bubbles.note: Option in the flow line look list: round bubbles that travel along the line.

look-editor.element.by-value.note: Option in the colour mode button group (with Single and Gradient): the colour follows the entity's value. Not a price or payment term.

look-editor.element.cable.note: Option name for a line style that looks like a twisted cable, beside Tube. Choice in a button group.

look-editor.element.chevron.note: Name of a travelling shape on a flow line: a V-shaped arrow mark, like a greater-than sign.

look-editor.element.colour.note: Field label for a colour picker in the flow line look. A noun.

look-editor.element.colour-mode.note: Label of the button group that chooses how the line gets its colour: Single, Gradient or By value.

look-editor.element.colour-ranges.note: Option and heading for colouring the flow line by value bands, such as blue below 10 and red above 30.

look-editor.element.comet.note: Name of a travelling shape on a flow line: a bright head with a fading tail.

look-editor.element.core-colour.note: Colour picker label: the colour of the bright centre of a glowing line, as opposed to its outer glow.

look-editor.element.count-follows-spacin.note: Hint next to the shape count in the flow look editor. Says the count is worked out from the spacing setting.

look-editor.element.dash-length-px.note: Field label in the flow look editor. Sets how long each dash is, in pixels.

look-editor.element.dashed.note: Option in the flow line look list: a line drawn as short dashes. Adjective.

look-editor.element.default-look.note: Name of the look used when no preset is chosen, for flow lines. Shown as a tile in the preset list. The slider editor has its own key.

look-editor.element.diamond.note: Name of a travelling shape on a flow line: a square turned on its corner.

look-editor.element.different-start-mark.note: Switch label in the flow look editor. Lets the line start with a marker that differs from the end marker.

look-editor.element.dismiss.note: Button on a warning notice that hides the notice. Also the close label of the undo toast.

look-editor.element.dot.note: Option name for a moving shape: a round dot (singular). The plural 'Dots' is a number field label.

look-editor.element.dot-size-px.note: Field label in the flow look editor. Sets the diameter of each moving dot, in pixels.

look-editor.element.dots.note: Number field label: how many dots move along the line at once. Plural of the 'Dot' option.

look-editor.element.dotted.note: Option name for a line style made of dots, beside Solid and Dashed. An adjective.

look-editor.element.double-rail.note: Option in the flow line look list: two parallel lines, like a railway track.

look-editor.element.drop.note: Option name for a moving shape shaped like a water drop, beside Comet, Spark and Bubble. A noun, not the verb.

look-editor.element.electric.note: Switch label for a zigzag line: makes it flicker like an electric arc. An adjective.

look-editor.element.end-marker.note: Label of the mark drawn where a flow line ends, such as an arrowhead or dot.

look-editor.element.ends.note: Section heading in the flow line look for the start and end markers of the line. A plural noun, not the verb.

look-editor.element.even.note: Option in the spacing button group (with In pixels and Random): shapes are spread evenly along the line. Not 'even number'.

look-editor.element.fields-added.note: Status line under a look. {fields} is a comma-separated list of the names of the extra settings the look adds, for example 'Sheath colour, Twisted'. Keep the list intact.

vars.fields: The value that replaces fields in the text.

look-editor.element.flicker.note: Label of the button group (Off, Subtle, Strong) that sets how much the glow flickers. A noun.

look-editor.element.gap-px.note: Number field label: space between dashes or dots along the flow line, in pixels (px).

look-editor.element.glass-tint.note: Colour picker label: the tint of the glass-style tube. 'Glass' is the material and 'tint' the colour wash.

look-editor.element.glow-px.note: Number field label: radius of the soft glow around the flow line, in pixels (px).

look-editor.element.gradient.note: Option in the colour mode button group (Single, Gradient, By value): the line blends from one colour to another.

look-editor.element.icon.note: Label for the icon shown on the flow line (picker or heading). A noun.

look-editor.element.idle-colour.note: Colour picker label: the colour of the line when nothing is flowing (the entity is idle or off).

look-editor.element.in-pixels.note: Option in the spacing button group (with Even and Random): shapes are placed a fixed number of pixels apart.

look-editor.element.level-follows-value.note: Switch label in the flow look editor. Makes the tube fill level track the value of the chosen entity.

look-editor.element.line.note: Heading of the flow line section (the path itself, not a text line). A noun. Distinct from 'Line style'.

look-editor.element.line-end-colour.note: Colour field label in the flow look editor. Sets the colour at the far end of the line.

look-editor.element.line-style.note: Label of the button group that picks how the line is drawn: Solid, Dashed or Dotted.

look-editor.element.look-change-undone.note: Toast after undoing a change to a flow line look. Same English as the slider look editor toast.

look-editor.element.look-reset-n-removed.text: Look reset. {n, plural, one {# setting} other {# settings}} removed.
look-editor.element.look-reset-n-removed.note: Toast shown after the look is reset, followed by an Undo button. {n} is the number of settings removed from the card configuration.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

look-editor.element.marker-size-px.note: Field label in the flow look editor. Sets the size of the line's start and end markers, in pixels.

look-editor.element.motion.note: Label of the button group choosing how the shapes move: Travel along the line or Pulse in place. A noun.

look-editor.element.n-px.note: Pixel value shown beside a size control. {n} is a number; px stands for pixels.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

look-editor.element.name-look.note: Label of a look in the Look header. {name} is the name of a preset look, such as Neon or Wave. Same English as the slider key, which has its own context.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

look-editor.element.name-look-applied-n-.text: {name} look applied. {n, plural, one {# setting} other {# settings}} changed.
look-editor.element.name-look-applied-n-.note: Toast shown after a preset look is applied, followed by an Undo button. {name} is the look name; {n} is the number of settings changed.

vars.n: The count the text is about.
vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

look-editor.element.neon.note: Option in the flow line look list for a glowing neon line. Same English as the two presets.

look-editor.element.none.note: Option meaning 'no end marker' or 'no extra effect' in a button group; also the value shown when nothing is set.

look-editor.element.nothing-arrives-whil.text: Nothing arrives while Motion is Pulse.
look-editor.element.nothing-arrives-whil.note: Hint beside Splash on arrival in the flow look editor. Explains why no splash plays when Motion is set to Pulse.

look-editor.element.off.note: Option in the Flicker button group (Off, Subtle, Strong): no flicker. Not a switch state of an entity.

look-editor.element.pick-a-sensor-or-dev.text: Pick a sensor or device first: the colour follows its value.
look-editor.element.pick-a-sensor-or-dev.note: Hint in the flow look editor when colour follows value but no entity is chosen. Tells the user to pick one first.

look-editor.element.pick-a-sensor-or-dev.text: Pick a sensor or device first: the level follows its value.
look-editor.element.pick-a-sensor-or-dev.note: Hint in the flow look editor when the tube level follows a value but no entity is chosen. Tells the user to pick one first.

look-editor.element.pick-an-icon.note: Prompt in the flow look editor when a marker or shape is set to an icon but none is chosen yet.

look-editor.element.presets.note: Section heading above the ready-made look tiles for the flow line. A plural noun.

look-editor.element.pulse.note: Option in the Motion button group: shapes swell and fade in place instead of travelling. Also used as part of a summary. A noun or verb of the effect, not a heartbeat.

look-editor.element.rail-gap-px.note: Field label in the flow look editor. Sets the distance between the two rails of the line, in pixels.

look-editor.element.random.note: Option in the spacing button group (with Even and In pixels): shapes are placed at random positions.

look-editor.element.reset-look.note: Button in the flow line Look header that removes every look setting. An Undo toast follows.

look-editor.element.ring.note: Name of a travelling shape on a flow line: an open circle.

look-editor.element.rotate-with-the-line.note: Switch label in the flow look editor. Turns each shape to follow the direction of the line.

look-editor.element.round-node.note: Marker option for a flow line end: a filled round dot, as at a junction.

look-editor.element.scale-width.note: Switch label: the line gets thicker as the value rises, up to twice its width at Max. Verb phrase, not a measuring scale.

look-editor.element.shape.note: Label of the button group that picks the moving shape (Dot, Comet, Arrow and so on). Singular; 'Shapes' is a number field.

look-editor.element.shape-colour.note: Label of the colour of the shapes travelling along a flow line.

look-editor.element.shape-size-px.note: Field label in the flow look editor. Sets the size of each travelling shape, in pixels.

look-editor.element.shapes.note: Number field label: how many shapes move along the line at once. Plural of 'Shape'.

look-editor.element.shapes-stay-in-place.text: Shapes stay in place and pulse. The pulse speed follows the value.
look-editor.element.shapes-stay-in-place.note: Description of the Pulse option in the flow look editor Motion setting. Says shapes stay put and the entity value sets the pulse speed.

look-editor.element.sheath-colour.note: Colour picker label: the colour of the outer covering of a cable-style line, like the plastic jacket of a wire.

look-editor.element.single.note: Option in the colour mode button group (Single, Gradient, By value): one fixed colour.

look-editor.element.size-variation.note: Field label in the flow look editor. Sets how much shapes differ in size from one another, as a percentage.

look-editor.element.solid.note: Option in the Line style button group (Solid, Dashed, Dotted): an unbroken line. An adjective.

look-editor.element.spacing.note: Label of the button group choosing how shapes are spread along the line: Even, In pixels or Random.

look-editor.element.spacing-is-ignored-w.text: Spacing is ignored while Motion is Pulse.
look-editor.element.spacing-is-ignored-w.note: Hint beside the Spacing field in the flow look editor. Explains the setting has no effect when Motion is Pulse.

look-editor.element.spacing-px.note: Number field label: distance between shapes along the line, in pixels (px). Shown when spacing is In pixels.

look-editor.element.spark.note: Option name for a moving shape that looks like a spark, beside Comet, Bubble and Drop. A noun.

look-editor.element.spin.note: Switch label: the shape turns once every 3 seconds. Verb, not a washing-machine cycle.

look-editor.element.splash.note: Option in the Arrival button group: a small splash effect where shapes reach the end of the line. A noun.

look-editor.element.splash-on-arrival.note: Switch label in the flow look editor. Turns on a small splash at the destination when a shape arrives.

look-editor.element.splash-size-px.note: Field label in the flow look editor. Sets the size of the arrival splash, in pixels.

look-editor.element.spread-and-motion.note: Section heading in the flow look editor. Groups the spacing, size variation and motion settings.

look-editor.element.square.note: Name of a travelling shape on a flow line: a square with straight sides.

look-editor.element.star.note: Name of a travelling shape on a flow line: a five-pointed star.

look-editor.element.start-marker.note: Label of the mark drawn where a flow line begins, such as a dot.

look-editor.element.strong.note: Option in the Flicker button group (Off, Subtle, Strong): a pronounced flicker. An adjective.

look-editor.element.subtle.note: Option in the Flicker button group (Off, Subtle, Strong): a barely noticeable flicker. An adjective.

look-editor.element.the-flow-look-could-.text: The flow look could not be loaded, so the card keeps the classic flow. Your settings are saved.
look-editor.element.the-flow-look-could-.note: Error message in the flow look editor when the look code fails to load. Reassures the user the card falls back to the classic flow and nothing is lost.

look-editor.element.the-line-takes-the-c.text: The line takes the colour of the range the value falls in.
look-editor.element.the-line-takes-the-c.note: Hint in the flow look editor for colour-by-value. Explains the line uses the colour of the colour range that holds the current value.

look-editor.element.the-tube-is-empty-un.text: The tube is empty until the value passes Min.
look-editor.element.the-tube-is-empty-un.note: Hint under the Min field in the flow look editor. Explains the tube shows no fill until the value rises above Min.

look-editor.element.this-card-shows-at-m.text: This card shows at most 40 moving shapes. Some of this line's shapes are skipped.
look-editor.element.this-card-shows-at-m.note: Limit warning in the flow look editor. Appears when the card exceeds 40 moving shapes and tells the user some of this line's shapes are not drawn.

look-editor.element.travel.note: Option in the Motion button group (Travel, Pulse): shapes move along the line from start to end. A verb.

look-editor.element.tube.note: Option name for a line style that looks like a glass tube, beside Cable. Choice in a button group.

look-editor.element.turns-the-shape-once.text: Turns the shape once every 3 seconds while it travels. Off by default.
look-editor.element.turns-the-shape-once.note: Hint under a spin switch in the flow look editor. Says the shape makes one full turn every 3 seconds and that it starts switched off.

look-editor.element.twisted.note: Switch label for a cable-style line: draws the strands twisted around each other. An adjective.

look-editor.element.undo.note: Button and toast action that reverts the last look change. The longer 'Undo reset' and 'Undo {name} look' are separate keys.

look-editor.element.undo-name-look.note: Button that reverts a preset look just applied. {name} is the look name, such as Neon.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

look-editor.element.undo-reset.note: Button in the flow line Look header that restores the settings removed by Reset look.

look-editor.element.up-to-twice-the-widt.text: Up to twice the width at Max.
look-editor.element.up-to-twice-the-widt.note: Hint under the width-follows-value switch in the flow look editor. Says the line grows to twice its width when the value reaches Max.

look-editor.element.used-is-used-kept-bu.text: {used} is used. Kept but not used: {kept}.
look-editor.element.used-is-used-kept-bu.note: Help text when a look switches a setting on. {used} is the name of the colour setting now in effect; {kept} is a comma-separated list of settings still stored but ignored.

vars.kept: The value that replaces kept in the text.
vars.used: The value that replaces used in the text.

look-editor.element.wave.note: Option name for a line shape that follows a smooth wave, beside Zigzag. Choice in a button group, not a greeting.

look-editor.element.wave-height-px.note: Field label in the flow look editor. Sets how tall the waves of a wavy line are, in pixels.

look-editor.element.wavelength-px.note: Number field label: the distance between two peaks of the wave or zigzag, in pixels (px).

look-editor.element.width-px.note: Number field label: thickness of the flow line, in pixels (px). Not the card width.

look-editor.element.your-own-look.note: Heading for the flow line look the user built, not a preset. Same English as the slider look editor.

look-editor.element.your-own-look-starte.note: Description of a customised look. {name} is the name of the preset look it started from.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

look-editor.element.your-system-has-redu.text: Your system has reduced motion on, so this look stays still. Turn it off in your system settings to see it move.
look-editor.element.your-system-has-redu.note: Notice in the flow look editor when the device asks for reduced motion. Explains why the preview is static and how to see it move.

look-editor.element.zigzag.note: Option name for a line shape with sharp angled bends, beside Wave. Choice in a button group.

look-editor.element.zigzag-height-px.note: Field label in the flow look editor. Sets how tall the zigzags of a zigzag line are, in pixels.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.add-ev.note: Button that replaces the gradient stops with a chosen number of stops spread evenly across the slider's range.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.add-st.note: Button that adds one colour stop (a colour point) to the slider gradient. 'Stop' is a noun, not 'stop an action'.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.apply.note: Button next to the stop-count field that applies the Add evenly settings.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.auto.note: Option in the slider colour mode button group: the fill colour is chosen automatically from the entity. Capitalised; the lower-case 'auto' key is a separate string.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.auto-2.note: Lower-case word used inside a sentence or summary, meaning the colour is chosen automatically. Not a button label.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.auto-f.note: Option label in the slider look editor fill colour setting. Builds the fill automatically from the light's own colour.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.auto-w.text: Auto works with brightness and colour temperature sliders.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.auto-w.note: Hint under the Auto fill option in the slider look editor. Tells the user which slider types can use it.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.beside.note: Option label in the slider look editor value position setting. Puts the value text next to the slider.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.big-fi.note: Name of a slider preset look: a large, bold filled bar. Shown as a tile in the preset list.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.blur-b.note: Number field or switch label: blurs whatever is behind the slider track, the frosted-glass effect.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.blurs-.text: Blurs what is behind the track. Off gives a flat, see-through fill. Blur can slow down older wall tablets.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.blurs-.note: Hint under the blur switch in the slider look editor. Explains the effect and warns it can slow older wall tablets.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.border.note: Label of the colour of the line drawn around the slider track.
Label of the width of the slider track border, in pixels. Keep (px).

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.bright.text: Brightness: dark to bright in the slider colour. Colour temperature: warm to cool.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.bright.note: Hint in the slider look editor describing how the track gradient runs for a brightness slider and for a colour temperature slider.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.centre.note: Option in a position button group (such as Icon position): placed in the middle of the slider.
Hint on the Centre option in the slider look editor. Tells the user the option only works when the slider is vertical.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.circle.note: Option in the handle shape button group (with Square): a round handle.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.close.note: Button that closes the slider look editor panel. A verb, not 'near'.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.colour.note: Help text under the fill colour mode. {source} is where the slider fill colour comes from, for example the light's colour or a fixed colour.

vars.source: The value that replaces source in the text.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.defaul.note: Name of the slider look used when no preset is chosen. Shown as a tile in the preset list. The flow line editor has its own key.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.delete.note: Button label (also read by screen readers) that removes one colour stop of the slider gradient. {n} is the stop's position, starting at 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.end-co.note: Colour picker label: the last colour of the slider gradient, at the maximum end. Pairs with a start colour.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.entity.note: Option in the icon source button group: use the icon of the Home Assistant entity the slider controls.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.falls-.text: Falls back to Slider colour when the light has no colour.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.falls-.note: Hint under the follow-the-light option in the slider look editor. Says the fill uses Slider colour if the light reports none.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.fill.note: Section heading for the filled part of the slider track (the coloured bar showing the current value). A noun.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.follow.note: Section heading in the slider look editor. Groups the settings that make the fill follow the light's colour.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.gap-px.note: Number field label: space between the segments of a segmented slider, in pixels (px).

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.glass.note: Name of a slider preset look: frosted, see-through glass. Shown as a tile in the preset list; not a drinking glass.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.glow-p.note: Number field label: radius of the soft glow around the slider, in pixels (px).

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.gradie.note: Option in the slider fill colour mode button group: the fill blends through the colour stops.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.gradie.text: Gradient, light's colour to end colour
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.gradie.note: Option label in the slider look editor fill setting. Blends from the light's colour to the chosen end colour.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.handle.note: Section heading for the draggable knob of the slider. A noun, not a verb.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.hidden.note: Option in a button group (for example the label or handle): the element is not shown. An adjective.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.hidden.text: Hidden is the same as turning Show value off.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.hidden.note: Hint on the Hidden option of the value position in the slider look editor. Says it has the same result as switching Show value off.
Hint on the Hidden option in the slider look editor. Tells the user the value can only be hidden while the slider has a handle.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.icon.note: Section heading for the icon shown on the slider. A noun.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.icon-p.note: Label of the choice for where the slider icon sits, such as in the track or beside it.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.in-a-b.note: Option label in the slider look editor value position setting. Shows the value in a bubble only while the user drags.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.in-the.note: Option label in the slider look editor value position setting. Draws the value text inside the track.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.in-you.text: In your system settings, turn on reduced motion (Accessibility).
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.in-you.note: Help line in the slider look editor reduced-motion notice. Tells the user where the system setting lives on a generic device.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.label.note: Section heading for the text labels at the slider ends (for example min and max). A noun.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.light-.note: Value shown after 'Colour source:' when the fill takes the actual colour of the light entity. 'Light' is a Home Assistant light.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.line.note: Option in the handle shape button group: a thin line handle. A noun.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.look-c.note: Toast after undoing a change to a slider look. Same English as the flow line toast.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.look-r.text: {count, plural, one {Look reset. # setting removed.} other {Look reset. # settings removed.}}
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.look-r.note: Toast after the slider look is reset, followed by an Undo button. {count} is the number of settings removed.

vars.count: The count the text is about.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.min-an.note: Switch label in the slider look editor. Shows the lowest and highest values at the ends of the track.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.n-3.note: Summary beside the Stops heading. {n} is the number of colour stops in the slider gradient. A stop is one colour point along the gradient.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.n-char.text: {n, plural, one {# character of each label shows on the card. Screen readers get the full label.} other {# characters of each label show on the card. Screen readers get the full label.}}
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.n-char.note: Help text for the label length setting. {n} is a number, the maximum characters shown. 'Label' is the min and max text at the ends of the slider.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.n-stop.text: {n, plural, one {# stop is the most.} other {# stops are the most.}}
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.n-stop.note: Hint shown when the stop limit is reached. {n} is the maximum number of colour stops allowed (a number, always plural in practice).

vars.n: The most stops a slider can have.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.name-l.note: Label of a slider look in the Look header. {name} is the name of a slider preset look.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.name-l.text: {count, plural, one {{name} look applied. # setting changed.} other {{name} look applied. # settings changed.}}
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.name-l.note: Toast after a slider preset look is applied, followed by an Undo button. {name} is the look name; {count} is the number of settings changed.

vars.count: The count the text is about.
vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.name-l.note: Toast shown when the chosen preset changes nothing. {name} is the look name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.none.note: Summary value shown when the slider has no colour stops, and an option meaning 'no effect' in button groups.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.on-a-m.text: On a Mac: System Settings, Accessibility, Display.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.on-a-m.note: Help line in the slider look editor reduced-motion notice. Gives the menu path for turning reduced motion on a Mac.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.on-ipa.note: Help line in the slider look editor reduced-motion notice. Gives the menu path for turning reduced motion on an iPad.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.only-l.text: Only lights have a colour of their own.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.only-l.note: Hint in the slider look editor when the chosen entity is not a light. Explains why following the light's colour is unavailable.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.pick-a.note: Hint in the slider look editor when no entity is chosen yet. Asks the user to select a light before using the light's colour.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.pill.note: Option in the slider shape button group: a fully rounded, capsule-shaped bar. Not a medicine.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.preset.note: Section heading above the ready-made look tiles for the slider. A plural noun.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.replac.text: Replaces the stops with this many, spread from {min} to {max}.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.replac.note: Help text for a stop-count field. 'this many' refers to the number typed in that field. {min} and {max} are the slider's lowest and highest values (numbers).

vars.max: The value that replaces max in the text.
vars.min: The value that replaces min in the text.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.reset-.note: Small button that sets one field back to its default. {label} is that field's name in lower case, for example 'reset thickness'.

vars.label: The value that replaces label in the text.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.reset-.note: Button in the slider Look header that removes every look setting. An Undo toast follows.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.segmen.note: Option in the slider style button group: the track is split into separate blocks. An adjective.
Number field label: how many blocks a segmented slider is split into.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.sends-.text: Sends at most 4 changes a second. The final value always goes out when you let go. Off by default.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.sends-.note: Hint under the Update while dragging switch in the slider look editor. Explains the send rate limit and that the final value is always sent.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.shape.note: Label of the button group choosing the handle shape (Circle, Square, Line). Singular noun.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.size-p.note: Label of the size of the slider handle or icon, in pixels. Keep (px).

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.slider.note: Label of the main colour of the slider fill, used when it does not follow the light.
Label of the choice for the outline the slider follows, such as straight, arc or wave.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.snap-t.note: Switch label in the slider look editor. Makes the handle jump to the nearest colour stop instead of sliding freely.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.solid.note: Option in the slider fill colour mode button group: one flat colour with no gradient. An adjective.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.sort-b.note: Button label in the slider look editor colour stops list. Reorders the stops from the lowest value to the highest.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.square.note: Option in the handle shape button group (with Circle): a square handle. An adjective or noun, not a town square.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.standa.note: Option in the slider style button group: the normal continuous track, as opposed to Segmented. An adjective.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.start.note: Option in a position button group: placed at the minimum end of the slider. Not a command to begin.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.stop-n.note: Label of one colour stop in the gradient list. {n} is its position, starting at 1.

vars.n: The value that replaces n in the text.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.stop-o.note: Warning label on a colour stop row in the slider look editor. Flags a stop whose value falls outside the slider's min and max.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.stops.note: Section heading for the list of gradient colour stops (colour points). A plural noun, not the verb.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-li.text: The light's colour, if that is on, or Slider colour is where the fill starts. Gradient and Auto build on it.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-li.note: Hint under the fill start colour in the slider look editor. Explains where the fill begins and that Gradient and Auto build on it.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-lo.text: The long side. The short side is 0.57 times that.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-lo.note: Hint under the size field in the slider look editor. Says the value sets the long side and the short side follows at 0.57 times.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-mo.text: The module's own corners are in the Design tab.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-mo.note: Hint under Track corners in the slider look editor. Points the user to the Design tab for the module's outer corners.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-sl.text: The slider look could not be loaded, so the card keeps the standard slider. Your settings are saved.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-sl.note: Error message in the slider look editor when the look code fails to load. Reassures the user the standard slider is used and settings are kept.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-to.text: The touch area stays at least 40 px.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-to.note: Hint under the track thickness field in the slider look editor. Reassures the user that thin tracks still keep a 40 px touch target.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-tr.text: The track and fill follow this shape. The handle stays on the track. Use a wide or tall shape for the clearest result.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-tr.note: Hint under the custom shape picker in the slider look editor. Explains how the track, fill and handle use the shape and which shapes work best.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-tr.text: The track still moves and can be used with keyboard and touch. Add a value display so people can read the level.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.the-tr.note: Accessibility hint in the slider look editor when there is no handle. Says the slider still works and suggests showing the value.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.thickn.note: Label of how thick the slider track is, in pixels. Keep (px).

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.thin.note: Name of a slider preset look: a slim, narrow bar. Shown as a tile in the preset list. An adjective.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.tick-e.note: Number field label: draw a tick mark on the slider every this many units. Read as 'Tick every [number]'. A tick is a small scale mark.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.ticks.note: Label of the small scale marks drawn along the slider track. Noun, not the verb.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.touch-.text: Touch screens have no hover, so the value is shown for 2 seconds after you let go.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.touch-.note: Hint on the show-on-hover value option in the slider look editor. Explains the 2 second fallback on touch screens.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.track-.note: Section heading in the slider look editor. Groups the track and fill colour, corner and gradient settings.
Field label in the slider look editor. Sets the corner radius of the track, in pixels.
Label of the choice for how the slider track looks, such as solid or see-through glass.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.undo.note: Button that reverses the last change to the slider look. Verb.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.undo-l.note: Button label in the slider look editor. Reverts the last look change the user made.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.undo-n.note: Button that reverts a slider preset look just applied. {name} is the look name.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.undo-r.note: Button that brings back the slider look as it was before the reset.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.update.note: Switch label in the slider look editor. Sends the value to the device during a drag, not only on release.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.use-ow.note: Option to colour the slider with a colour picked here instead of the light's colour.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.use-th.note: Switch label in the slider look editor. Colours the fill with the colour the light is currently showing.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.value.note: Label of the number the slider currently holds, shown on the slider. Noun.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.value-.note: Label of the choice for how the slider's current number is shown, such as on hover or always.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.value-.text: Value shown beside the slider, because there is no handle.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.value-.note: Notice in the slider look editor. Explains the value moves beside the slider automatically when the handle is removed.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.where.note: Short label of the choice for the position of the value display relative to the slider.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.with-n.text: With no handle and no value shown, the level can only be read from the fill.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.with-n.note: Warning in the slider look editor when both handle and value are hidden. Tells the user the level is only visible from the fill.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.your-o.note: Heading for the slider look the user built, not a preset. Same English as the flow line editor.
Description of a customised slider look. {name} is the name of the preset look it started from.

vars.name: The value that replaces name in the text.

look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.your-s.text: Your system has reduced motion on, so this look stays still.
look-editor.mc-slider-look-editor.your-s.note: Notice in the slider look editor when the device asks for reduced motion. Explains why the preview does not animate.

look-editor.presets.big-fill.note: Name of a slider preset with a large filled track.

look-editor.presets.blue-tube-with-drops.text: Blue tube with drops and a rising level.
look-editor.presets.blue-tube-with-drops.note: Preset description on a look preset card. Summarises what the preset looks like before the user applies it.

look-editor.presets.cool-dashed-line-wit.note: Preset description on a flow look preset card. Summarises the look before the user applies it.

look-editor.presets.data.note: Name of a flow line preset with a data-transfer look, as for network traffic.

look-editor.presets.energy.note: Name of a flow line preset with a glowing yellow-orange look, with sparks.

look-editor.presets.glass.note: Name of a slider preset with a see-through, glass-like track.

look-editor.presets.glowing-line-round-g.note: Preset description on a slider look preset card. Summarises the look before the user applies it.

look-editor.presets.glowing-yellow-orang.note: Preset description on a flow look preset card. Summarises the look before the user applies it.

look-editor.presets.heat.note: Name of a flow line preset with a warm look, with comets. Noun, not temperature.

look-editor.presets.large-fill-with-icon.text: Large fill with icon and value. Updates while you drag.
look-editor.presets.large-fill-with-icon.note: Preset description on a slider look preset card. Summarises the look and says it sends updates during a drag.

look-editor.presets.material.note: Name of a slider preset in the Material Design style: standard bar, round handle.

look-editor.presets.minimal.note: Name of a slider preset with a thin, plain look. Adjective.

look-editor.presets.neon.note: Name of the flow line preset with a glowing neon look. Same English as the slider preset and the flow look.

look-editor.presets.neon-2.note: Name of the slider preset with a glowing neon line and handle. Same English as the flow preset.

look-editor.presets.pink-glowing-line-wi.note: Preset description on a flow look preset card. Summarises the look before the user applies it.

look-editor.presets.see-through-track-pi.note: Preset description on a slider look preset card. Summarises the look before the user applies it.

look-editor.presets.standard-bar-with-a-.text: Standard bar with a round handle.
look-editor.presets.standard-bar-with-a-.note: Preset description on a slider look preset card. Summarises the default-style look before the user applies it.

look-editor.presets.thin-line-round-hand.text: Thin line, round handle, value beside it.
look-editor.presets.thin-line-round-hand.note: Preset description on a slider look preset card. Summarises the look before the user applies it.

look-editor.presets.warm-wavy-line-with-.note: Preset description on a flow look preset card. Summarises the look before the user applies it.

look-editor.presets.water.note: Name of a flow line preset with a blue tube, drops and a rising level.
